title: Convergence of uniformly bounded linear functionals
statement: Let $E$ be a complex normed vector space, let $(L_m)_{m\in\mathbb N}$ and $M$ be continuous complex-linear functionals from $E$ to $\mathbb C$, and let $C\in\mathbb R$. Suppose that $\|L_m(y)\|\le C\|y\|$ for every $m$ and $y\in E$, and that the complex linear span of a set $S\subseteq E$ is dense in $E$. If $L_m(y)\to M(y)$ for every $y\in S$, then $L_m(x)\to M(x)$ for every $x\in E$.
hypotheses_covered: $E$ is a complex normed vector space
A real constant $C$ bounds $\|L_m(y)\|$ by $C\|y\|$ for every $m,y$
The complex linear span of $S$ is dense in $E$
